data.one_liner: Shows non-blocking toast notifications at any position and duration.
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple API to display toast messages anywhere in a Flutter app. You can choose the screen position and how long the toast stays visible. Works on mobile, web, and desktop platforms.
use_when: You need quick, in‑app feedback without blocking UI
You want a lightweight toast solution that works across all Flutter platforms
avoid_when: You require rich notification features like actions, scheduling, or background delivery
You need integration with push‑notification services
strengths: Very easy to integrate and use
Supports Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux
weaknesses: Limited to simple toast UI, no advanced features
No support for persistent or actionable notifications

alternatives.name: fluttertoast
alternatives.why_pick_it: Mature, widely used toast library with similar API

alternatives.name: bot_toast
alternatives.why_pick_it: More customization options and built‑in animation support

alternatives.name: toastification
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers theming and richer UI for toast messages
